claims.text: Cross-channel dependencies are essential for accurate forecasts on high-correlation datasets like ETTh1, Weather, Electricity.
iTransformer is best characterised as inverted transformer treating variates as tokens.

evidence.description: iTransformer improves MSE by 34% over channel-independent PatchTST on ETTh1.

methodologies.name: iTransformer
methodologies.description: inverted transformer treating variates as tokens

limitations.text: Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured.
Distribution shift between train and test periods is not explicitly modelled.

future_work.text: Applying the method to irregularly sampled clinical time series.
Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
